Ken Graham writes here as **klogram**.

He is an ML engineer at AppFolio, in Nashville. Before that work he trained as a physicist (Ph.D., condensed matter). The notes on this site come out of NLP, agents, causal inference, and the systems that have to hold those things up.

He is a co-author of [*Transformers for Machine Learning*](https://www.routledge.com/Transformers-for-Machine-Learning-A-Deep-Dive/Kamath-Graham-Emara/p/book/9780367771652) (Chapman & Hall / CRC, with Uday Kamath and Wael Emara) and [*Applied Causal Inference*](https://appliedcausalinference.github.io/aci_book/) (with Uday Kamath and Mitchell Naylor).

Code lives at [github.com/klgraham](https://github.com/klgraham). The site repository is [klgraham/klogram](https://github.com/klgraham/klogram).
